\摘要\ABSTRACT

受大型语言模型（LLM）级联的推动，我们提出了一种在线上下文潘多拉魔盒模型 用于自适应查询和选择 LLM API。在每个 期间，决策者观察请求上下文并面临两个阶段 决策问题。在查询阶段，决策者依次查询 API，其中每个查询都会显示生成的输出，并且决策者会产生（依赖于输出的）成本。在选择阶段，决策者选择生成的输出之一进行部署 并仅观察已部署输出的下游奖励。这个 输出介导的反馈结构不同于经典的在线情境 潘多拉魔盒模型，打开盒子会直接显示其奖励。Motivated by Large Language Model (LLM) cascading, we propose an online contextual Pandora’s Box model for adaptively querying and selecting LLM APIs. In each period, a decision-maker observes a request context and faces a two-phase decision problem. In the query phase, the decision-maker sequentially queries APIs, where each query reveals a generated output and the decision-maker incurs an (output-dependent) cost. In the selection phase, the decision-maker selects one of the generated outputs to deploy and observes only the downstream reward of the deployed output. This output-mediated feedback structure differs from classical online contextual Pandora’s Box models, in which opening a box directly reveals its reward.

而不是估计完整的条件产出和成本分布 对于每个 API，我们直接对预订索引进行建模，并为查询阶段开发学习方法。具体来说，我们对经典韦茨曼策略引发的上下文保留索引函数施加参数结构。我们的策略将这些保留指数的广义矩量法 (GMM) 类型估计与这些指数和共享输出水平奖励评估器的 UCB 式置信界限相结合。在正则条件下，我们证明所得到的 政策实现维度依赖Rather than estimating the full conditional output and cost distributions of each API, we directly model the reservation index and develop a learning approach for the query phase. Specifically, we impose a parametric structure on the contextual reservation index functions induced by the classical Weitzman’s policy. Our policy combines generalized method of moments (GMM) type estimation of these reservation indices with UCB-style confidence bounds for both these indices and the shared output-level reward evaluator. Under regularity conditions, we prove that the resulting policy achieves dimension-dependentO~​(T)\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{T})累积的遗憾cumulative regret over a horizon ofTT期间。periods.

1 简介Introduction

大型语言模型 (LLM) 的激增改变了内容生成和决策支持的经济学。公司越来越多地使用生成式人工智能系统来生成广告、生成代码、满足客户请求以及执行复杂的分析任务。在这些应用中，运营挑战往往不是能否生成内容，而是如何可靠且经济高效地大规模生成高质量内容。例如，每天制作大量广告的公司可能可以访问 LLM API 组合，这些 API 的成本和输出质量因任务类型而异。一般来说，功能更强大的专有模型可以提供更高质量的输出，但会产生 成本大幅增加，而较小或专门的型号可能更便宜但可靠性较差。由于模型性能因请求上下文而异，并且很难先验预测输出的质量，因此使用单个 API 通常不是最佳的。同样，查询所有可用的 API 通常成本高昂。The proliferation of Large Language Models (LLMs) has transformed the economics of content generation and decision support. Firms increasingly use generative AI systems to generate advertisements, produce code, serve customer requests, and conduct complex analytical tasks. In these applications, the operational challenge is often not whether content can be generated, but how to generate high-quality content reliably and cost-effectively at scale. A firm that produces a high volume of advertisements per day, for example, may have access to a portfolio of LLM APIs that differ in cost and output quality across task types. More capable proprietary models may, in general, deliver higher-quality outputs but incur substantially higher costs, while smaller or specialized models may be cheaper but less reliable. Because model performance varies across request contexts and it is difficult to predict the quality of the outputs a priori, committing to a single API is often suboptimal. Similarly, querying all of the available APIs is typically prohibitively costly.

我们从使用外部或内部 LLM API 来服务业务请求流的组织的角度来研究这个问题。在此类应用程序中，请求作为不同的决策单元到达，没有严格的延迟要求，从而允许决策者在选择最终输出之前查询多个 API。值得注意的是，这种请求级决策问题与大型 LLM 平台面临的模型托管问题根本不同，其中一个关键的运营挑战是通过批处理、调度和负载管理来减少延迟We study this problem from the perspective of an organization that uses external or internal LLM APIs to serve a stream of business requests. In such applications, requests arrive as distinct decision units without a strict latency requirement, allowing the decision-maker to query more than one API before selecting a final output. It is worth noting that this request-level decision problem fundamentally differs from the model hosting problem faced by large LLM platforms, where a key operational challenge is to reduce latency through batching, scheduling, and load management(e.g. Yu et al. 2022, Kwon et al. 2023, Agrawal et al. 2024, Ao et al. 2025, Jaillet et al. 2025)。相反，我们的重点是 API 消费者的决策问题，即动态查询 API 组合，以经济高效的方式确保高质量的输出。. Our focus is instead on the API consumer’s decision problem of dynamically querying a portfolio of APIs to secure high-quality outputs in a cost-effective manner.

管理这种成本质量权衡的重要方法 是A prominent approach for managing this cost-quality trade-off is法学硕士级联LLM cascading (see e.g., Chen et al. 2025a, Yue et al. 2024, Gupta et al. 2024)。 级联不是将每个请求直接发送到单个昂贵的模型，而是按顺序查询 LLM API，通常从成本较低的模型开始，仅在早期输出显得不够可靠时才升级。 的开创性工作. Rather than sending every request directly to a single expensive model, a cascade queries LLM APIs sequentially, typically beginning with lower-cost models and escalating only when earlier outputs appear insufficiently reliable. The pioneering work ofChen et al. (2025a)例如，通过一系列 LLM API 路由查询并在生成的响应从评估器收到足够高的可靠性分数后停止，从而说明了这种设计。级联允许简单的请求由更便宜的 API 处理，只有困难的请求才会升级为昂贵的请求。经验证据来自, for example, illustrates this design by routing a query through a sequence of LLM APIs and stopping once a generated response receives a sufficiently high reliability score from an evaluator. Cascading allows the easy requests to be handled by cheaper APIs, with only the difficult requests escalated to the expensive ones. Empirical evidence fromChen et al. (2025a)表明这种级联可以大大降低推理成本，同时保持任务性能，在某些情况下还可以提高任务性能。suggests that such cascades can substantially reduce inference costs while preserving, and in some cases improving, task performance.

LLM 级联系统提出了一个基本的顺序决策问题。对于每个传入请求，决策者必须管理查询阶段和选择阶段。在查询阶段，决策者必须决定接下来要查询哪个 API 以及生成的输出是否证明继续搜索是合理的。在选择阶段，决策者必须决定部署哪些生成的输出。这些决策是紧密耦合的。查询另一个 API 的成本很高，但可能会显示更好的输出；尽早停止查询阶段可以节省成本，但会显着增加无法生成更好结果的风险；在查询的输出中进行选择需要评估其下游价值。因此，LLM级联不仅仅是一个模型路由问题，而是一个信息获取成本高昂的顺序搜索问题。The LLM cascading system raises a fundamental sequential decision problem. For each incoming request, the decision-maker must manage both a query phase and a selection phase. In the query phase, the decision-maker must decide which API to query next and whether the generated outputs justify continuing the search. In the selection phase, the decision-maker must decide which of the generated outputs to deploy. These decisions are tightly coupled. Querying another API is costly, but it may reveal a better output; stopping the query phase early saves cost, but significantly increases the risks of not generating a better outcome; and selecting among queried outputs requires evaluating their downstream value. Thus, LLM cascading is not simply a model-routing problem, but a sequential search problem with costly information acquisition.

对这个搜索问题进行原理性分析的一个自然起点是经典的潘多拉魔盒问题。考虑一个理想化的基准，其中对于每个请求，决策者知道每个 API 生成的输出成本对的上下文相关分布，并且可以在观察到任何生成的输出后评估其下游值。在这个基准测试中，查询API相当于打开一个盒子，推理成本充当检查成本，生成输出的下游值充当实现的奖励。对于这个公式，开创性的工作A natural starting point for principled analysis of this search problem is the classical Pandora’s Box problem. Consider an idealized benchmark in which, for each request, the decision-maker knows the context-dependent distribution of the output-cost pair generated by each API and can evaluate the downstream value of any generated output once it is observed. In this benchmark, querying an API corresponds to opening a box, the inference cost acts as the inspection cost, and the downstream value of the generated output serves as the realized reward. For this formulation, the seminal work ofWeitzman (1979)描述了最优策略的结构。具体来说，给定请求的上下文，策略为每个 API 分配一个预留索引，然后按这些索引的降序查询 API，并在输出的奖励超过最高剩余索引时立即终止搜索。characterizes the structure of the optimal policy. Specifically, given the context of a request, the policy assigns each API a reservation index, then queries APIs in decreasing order of these indices, and terminates the search as soon as the reward of an output exceeds the highest remaining index.

然而，LLM 级联的实际应用在以学习为中心的方式上偏离了这一预言基准。查询 API 的价值本质上是与上下文相关的，而预言机 Weitzman 策略所需的原语很少能提前知道。在某些情况下，公司可能拥有关于先前人类或人工智能生成的输出及其下游奖励的大量历史数据，使他们能够构建奖励函数的准确离线模型。然而，在许多其他情况下，这种输出奖励对是有限的或不可用的。此外，即使可以根据离线数据对奖励进行建模，部署 LLM API 的公司通常也不知道每个 API 在给定请求上下文下生成的输出和成本的条件分布。由于请求随着时间的推移按顺序到达，因此决策者必须学习上下文相关的预留索引，同时继续做出成本敏感的查询和选择决策。这自然会导致 LLM 级联的在线上下文潘多拉魔盒公式。Real applications of LLM cascading, however, depart from this oracle benchmark in ways that make learning central. The value of querying an API is inherently contextual, and the primitives required by the oracle Weitzman’s policy are rarely known in advance. In some settings, firms may have substantial historical data on prior human- or AI-generated outputs and their downstream rewards, allowing them to construct an accurate offline model of the reward function. In many others, however, such output-reward pairs are limited or unavailable. Moreover, even when rewards can be modeled from offline data, a firm deploying LLM APIs typically does not know the conditional distribution of outputs and costs generated by each API under a given request context. Since requests arrive sequentially over time, the decision-maker must learn context-dependent reservation indices while continuing to make cost-sensitive query and selection decisions. This naturally leads to an online contextual Pandora’s Box formulation of LLM cascading.

最近关于法学硕士级联的工作已经开发出越来越复杂的方法来平衡成本和性能。其中包括预算受限的级联策略、不确定性或基于阈值的延迟规则，以及将级联与模型路由相结合的混合方法Recent work on LLM cascading has developed increasingly sophisticated methods for balancing cost and performance. Those include budget-constrained cascade policies, uncertainty or threshold-based deferral rules, and hybrid methods that combine cascading with model routing(Chen et al. 2025a, Yue et al. 2024, Gupta et al. 2024, Zhang et al. 2024)。虽然这些方法为高效的多法学硕士部署提供了重要的见解，但它们主要依赖于启发式设计。据我们所知，现有的工作尚未将LLM级联表述为具有联合查询和选择的在线上下文潘多拉魔盒问题，也没有制定正式的遗憾保证。 相反，现有的潘多拉魔盒文献并不是直接针对这种法学硕士环境量身定制的。 一个突出的工作领域采用分布式学习方法. While these approaches provide important insights into efficient multi-LLM deployment, they rely primarily on heuristic designs. To the best of our knowledge, existing work has not yet formulated LLM cascading as an online contextual Pandora’s Box problem with joint query and selection, nor developed formal regret guarantees. Conversely, existing Pandora’s Box literature are not directly tailored to this LLM setting. A prominent line of work takes distribution-learning approaches(Liu et al. 2025)，其中打开一个盒子会显示标量奖励，并且学习者在完整分布的参数结构下估计奖励分布如何随上下文变化。 离我们的工作更近了，, in which opening a box reveals a scalar reward and the learner estimates how the reward distribution varies with context, under parametric structure on the full distribution. Closer to our work,Atsidakou et al. (2024)直接参数化上下文保留指数，但他们的模型仍然是经典的潘多拉魔盒设置，其中打开的盒子直接显示奖励。相比之下，在 LLM 级联中，API 调用揭示了随机的输出成本对。在我们的模型中，下游价值取决于请求和生成的输出，而 API 特定的异质性通过输出和成本的分配进入。parameterizes contextual reservation indices directly, but their model remains a classical Pandora’s box setting in which opened boxes reveal rewards directly. In LLM cascading, by contrast, an API call reveals a stochastic output-cost pair. In our model, the downstream value depends on the request and the generated output, while API-specific heterogeneity enters through the distribution of outputs and costs.

1.1 我们的贡献Our Contributions

我们做出了三项主要贡献。首先，我们介绍一个由 LLM 级联驱动的在线上下文潘多拉魔盒模型。与现有的在线潘多拉魔盒模型不同，我们的模型具有自然的两阶段决策结构：查询 API 会显示随机输出并产生成本，而只有在选择并部署一个生成的输出后才能观察到下游奖励。这个公式抓住了 LLM 级联的一个关键实用特征：API 特定的异质性通过生成的输出和成本的分布进入，而生成的下游价值 输出是通过请求-输出对上的共享奖励模型来评估的。也就是说，API只能通过生成的输出影响下游值。We make three main contributions. First, we introduce an online contextual Pandora’s Box model motivated by LLM cascading. Unlike existing online Pandora’s Box models, our model features a natural two-phase decision structure: querying an API reveals a stochastic output and incurs a cost, while the downstream reward is observed only after one generated output is selected and deployed. This formulation captures a key practical feature of LLM cascading: API-specific heterogeneity enters through the distributions of generated outputs and costs, while the downstream value of a generated output is evaluated through a shared reward model on the request-output pair. That is, an API can influence the downstream value only through the generated output.

其次，我们提出了一种针对查询阶段的直接索引建模和学习方法。 在全信息基准中，Weitzman 的策略由上下文保留指数控制，该指数由每个 API 的条件输出和成本分布以及奖励评估器引起。我们不是直接估计这些分布，而是对保留索引函数本身施加参数结构，作为可观察上下文特征的广义线性函数。这种建模假设在法学硕士级联设置中产生了一种实用的基于乐观的学习方法，因为决策者可以专注于通过矩方程从查询的输出成本样本构建乐观框特定的保留指数，而不是完整的条件输出分布。 该策略还从部署的输出奖励中学习共享的输出级别奖励评估器，并且两个学习对象共同确定级联的查询和选择决策。Second, we propose a direct index modeling and learning approach for the query phase. In the full-information benchmark, Weitzman’s policy is governed by contextual reservation indices, which are induced by each API’s conditional output and cost distributions together with the reward evaluator. Rather than estimating these distributions directly, we impose a parametric structure on the reservation index functions themselves as a generalized linear function of observable context features. This modeling assumption leads to a practical optimism-based learning approach in the LLM cascading setting, as the decision-maker can focus on constructing optimistic box-specific reservation indices from queried output-cost samples through the moment equations instead of the full conditional output distributions. The policy also learns the shared output-level reward evaluator from deployed-output rewards, and the two learned objects jointly determine the cascade’s querying and selection decisions.

第三，我们对由此产生的在线保单提供后悔保证。该政策结合了Third, we provide regret guarantees for the resulting online policy. The policy combines广义矩量法generalized method of moments(GMM) 估计保留指数(GMM) estimation for reservation indices with置信上限upper confidence bound(UCB) 式的指数和奖励方法。我们的政策的动机是在乐观的情况下进行简单但至关重要的遗憾分解：累积的遗憾从估计保留指数中分离出错误。(UCB)-style approaches for both the indices and rewards. Our policy is motivated by a simple but crucial regret decomposition under optimism: cumulative regret separates into errors from estimating reservation indices for only the查询的APIqueried APIs以及仅评估生成的输出的错误and errors from evaluating generated outputs for only the选定的 APIselected APIs。 这种分解使我们能够将 UCB 式分析应用于我们的矩估计问题，从而产生与维度相关的. This decomposition allows us to apply the UCB-style analysis to our moment estimation problem, yielding a dimension-dependentO~​(T)\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})累积后悔界限。该分析涵盖了实际重要的已知评估器制度，其中离线数据提供了准确的输出水平奖励模型，以及必须在线联合学习评估器和保留指数的完整制度。cumulative regret bound. The analysis covers the practically important known-evaluator regime, where offline data provide an accurate output-level reward model, as well as the full regime where the evaluator and reservation indices must be learned jointly online.

1.2 相关文献Related Literature

我们的工作涉及成本感知法学硕士系统、顺序测试时间推理以及顺序搜索和在线学习的理论框架的文献。Our work is related to the literature on cost-aware LLM systems, sequential test-time inference, and the theoretical frameworks of sequential search and online learning.

首先，我们的论文与LLM级联和成本意识多LLM部署的新兴文献密切相关。该文献研究了当模型的成本、延迟和输出质量不同时，如何在多个 LLM API 之间分配推理请求。代表性方法包括 FrugalGPTFirst, our paper is closely related to the emerging literature on LLM cascading and cost-aware multi-LLM deployment. This literature studies how to allocate inference requests across multiple LLM APIs when models differ in cost, latency, and output quality. Representative approaches include FrugalGPT(Chen et al. 2025a)、预算受限的级联策略、基于不确定性或可靠性的延迟规则以及将级联与模型路由相结合的混合方法, budget-constrained cascade policies, uncertainty- or reliability-based deferral rules, and hybrid methods that combine cascading with model routing(Nie et al. 2024, Chen et al. 2024, Zhang et al. 2024, Yue et al. 2024, Gupta et al. 2024)。我们的工作通过将 LLM 级联表述为在线上下文潘多拉魔盒问题，为该文献做出了贡献，决策者在未知的、上下文相关的输出和成本分布下依次决定要查询哪些 API 以及何时停止。我们的工作也与 LLM 路由和集成方法相关，尽管它们解决的决策问题与我们的 LLM 级联动机不同。路由方法通常会在之前为每个请求选择一个LLM 通过非预测规则或通过观察任何生成的输出 预测的质量、奖励或效用分数. Our work contributes to this literature by formulating LLM cascading as an online contextual Pandora’s Box problem, where the decision-maker sequentially decides which APIs to query and when to stop under unknown, context-dependent output and cost distributions. Our work is also related to LLM routing and ensembling methods although they address different decision problems than our LLM cascading motivation. Routing methods usually choose a single LLM for each request before observing any generated output, either through non-predictive rules or through predicted quality, reward, or utility scores(Hu et al. 2024, Shnitzer et al. 2023, Hari and Thomson 2023, Lu et al. 2024, Šakota et al. 2024, Mei et al. 2025)。此类方法捕获一次性模型选择，但不捕获自适应请求内搜索。集成方法聚合或综合多个法学硕士的输出，例如通过排名和融合候选答案. Such methods capture one-shot model choice but not adaptive within-request search. Ensemble methods aggregate or synthesize outputs from multiple LLMs, such as by ranking and fusing candidate responses(Jiang et al. 2023, Fang et al. 2024, Hu et al. 2025);他们专注于输出聚合，而不是在查询成本下顺序停止。; they focus on output aggregation rather than sequential stopping under query costs.

其次，我们的论文与最近关于 LLM 推理的顺序测试和顺序停止的工作相关。Second, our paper is related to recent work on sequential testing and sequential stopping for LLM inference.Huang et al. (2026)研究单个法学硕士的自适应自我一致性，其中系统按顺序对推理路径进行采样，并在以高后验置信度识别出最可能的答案后停止。study adaptive self-consistency for a single LLM, where the system sequentially samples reasoning paths and stops once the most-likely answer can be identified with high posterior confidence.Li et al. (2026)研究使用异构 LLM 的贝叶斯顺序测试，决策者自适应地选择要查询的 LLM，并在假设的后验置信度超过目标阈值时停止。这些论文将 LLM 推理表述为后验驱动的顺序测试，而我们的 LLM 级联模型侧重于对已实现的输出成本对的上下文顺序搜索，停止由保留索引控制，学习侧重于索引函数和输出级别奖励模型。study Bayesian sequential testing with heterogeneous LLMs, where the decision-maker adaptively chooses which LLM to query and stops once the posterior confidence for a hypothesis crosses a target threshold. These papers formulate LLM inference as posterior-driven sequential testing, whereas our LLM cascading model focuses on contextual sequential search over realized output-cost pairs, with stopping governed by reservation indices and learning focused on both the index functions and the output-level reward model.

第三，我们模型的查询阶段组件扩展了上下文潘多拉魔盒问题。没有上下文的经典潘多拉魔盒问题源自Third, the query phase component of our model extends the contextual Pandora’s Box problem. The classic Pandora’s Box problem without contexts originates from the seminal work ofWeitzman (1979)此后一直在各种扩展下进行研究and has since been studied under a variety of extensions(e.g. Doval 2018, Chawla et al. 2020, Fu and Lin 2020, Boodaghians et al. 2020, Agarwal et al. 2024, Ezra et al. 2026)，包括在线变体, including online variants(Gergatsouli and Tzamos 2022, Atsidakou et al. 2024)。特别是，. In particular,Gergatsouli and Tzamos (2022)研究一种对抗性在线潘多拉魔盒设置，其中盒子奖励由对手选择。studies an adversarial online Pandora’s Box setting in which box rewards are chosen by an adversary.Gatmiry et al. (2024)随后表明，在这种情况下，即使有全信息反馈，也没有算法可以实现针对最优策略的次线性后悔。对于在线上下文潘多拉魔盒问题，subsequently shows that, in this setting, no algorithm can achieve sublinear regret against the optimal policy, even with full-information feedback. For the online contextual Pandora’s Box problem,Liu et al. (2025)获得遗憾界限obtains a regret bound ofO~​(T)\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{T})因为在假设下 每个框的奖励分布是上下文不变噪声分布的位置偏移，但其结果并未应用每个框内跨上下文的异构输出分布，这是 LLM 级联应用的关键特征。for under the assumption that the reward distribution of each box is a location shift of a context-invariant noise distribution, but their results does not apply heterogeneous output distributions across contexts within each box, a key feature for LLM cascading applications.Atsidakou et al. (2024)研究了对抗性到达上下文下的上下文潘多拉魔盒模型，其中最佳保留指数被参数化为观察到的上下文的线性函数。在这种一般环境下，他们获得了studies a contextual Pandora’s Box model under adversarially arriving contexts, where the optimal reservation index is parametrized as a linear function of the observed context. In this general setting, they obtain anO~​(T5/6)\widetilde{O}(T^{5/6})通过将学习问题简化为在线线性回归来限制后悔。 我们的方法建立在类似的模型之上regret bound by reducing the learning problem to online linear regression. Our approach builds on a similar model ofAtsidakou et al. (2024)通过强加参数化保留索引结构，但通过结合 GMM 和 UCB 分析采用不同的学习方法。这使我们能够提出一种基于乐观的学习算法by imposing a parametric reservation index structure, but adopts a different learning approach through a combination of GMM and UCB analysis. This allows us to propose an optimism-based learning algorithm withO~​(T)\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{T})在适当的规律性假设下遗憾的界限。regret bound under suitable regularity assumptions.

此外，我们模型的选择阶段借鉴了广义线性上下文老虎机的文献。这一系列工作源于开创性的论文Further, the selection phase of our model draws on the literature on generalized linear contextual bandits. This line of work originates from the seminal paper ofFilippi et al. (2010)，它引入了一种基于乐观的广义线性老虎机算法，并已向各个方向扩展, which introduces an optimism-based algorithm for generalized linear bandits, and has since been extended in various directions(e.g. Jun et al. 2017, Kveton et al. 2020, Ding et al. 2021, Kim et al. 2023).

最后，我们的学习算法将 GMM 与 UCB 型算法结合起来。 GMM 起源于Finally, our learning algorithm combines the GMM with an UCB–type algorithm. GMM originates from the seminal work ofHansen (1982)并在计量经济学领域得到了广泛的发展和应用and has been widely developed and applied in econometrics(e.g. Newey and McFadden 1994, Arellano and Bond 1991, Chamberlain 1987, Lin and Lee 2010, Cheng et al. 2024, Andrews and Mikusheva 2022, Hansen and Lee 2021)。 UCB 型算法可以追溯到 的开创性论文. UCB-type algorithms trace back to the seminal paper ofLai and Robbins (1985)此后在强盗文献中得到了广泛的研究and have since been extensively studied in the bandit literature(e.g. Auer et al. 2002, Rusmevichientong and Tsitsiklis 2010, Filippi et al. 2010, Fan and Glynn 2025, Garivier and Cappé 2011, Audibert et al. 2009)以及更广泛的在线学习环境和运营管理应用, as well as in broader online learning settings and applications in operations management(e.g. Rakhlin and Sridharan 2013, Gao et al. 2022, Cheung et al. 2022, Mao et al. 2025).

此外，我们的论文属于关于法学硕士辅助决策的文献，涉及多个领域，包括运营管理In addition, our paper belongs to the growing literature on LLM-assisted decision making across a range of fields, including operations management(e.g. Chen and Chan 2024, Chen et al. 2025b, Simchi-Levi et al. 2026), 广告, advertising(e.g. Yang et al. 2023, Reisenbichler et al. 2025), 医疗保健, healthcare(e.g. Thirunavukarasu et al. 2023, Hager et al. 2024, Hao et al. 2025)等。, among others.

我们的上下文潘多拉盒子模型映射到 LLM 级联如下。句点对应于服务请求，方框对应于LLM API或API提示配置。查询框Our contextual Pandora’s box model maps to LLM cascading as follows. A period corresponds to a service request, and a box corresponds to an LLM API or an API-prompt configuration. Querying boxaa一旦产生一个候选输出once produces one candidate outputωa​t\omega_{at}，DM 然后停止或查询级联中的另一个框。因此，我们限制每个框在一段时间内最多被查询一次。这与LLM级联文献一致, the DM then either stops or queries another box in the cascade. We therefore restrict each box to be queried at most once within a period. This is consistent with the LLM cascading literature(Chen et al. 2025a)，其中请求通过一系列 API 进行路由，并且仅当评估器认为先前的输出不够可靠时才调用每个 API。, where a request is routed through a sequence of APIs and each API is invoked only if previous outputs are deemed to be not sufficiently reliable by the evaluator.

2.1 DM的问题与遗憾DM’s Problem and Regret

Such a formulation would lead to a one-shot API-as-arm policy, in which the decision-maker selects a single API for each request before observing any generated output. It does not, however, capture the adaptive information-acquisition structure of LLM cascading. The following example illustrates that such a restriction can create a constant per-period gap relative to the sequential-search benchmark, even when all primitives are known.

定理的分解The decomposition in Theorem3.3让我们能够利用乐观的原则来控制我们的遗憾。更具体地说， 如果一个盒子被频繁查询，它的查询数据集就会增长，而它的索引不确定性就会降低。如果一个盒子很少被查询，那么它只贡献 很少涉及定理的第二项allows us to leverage the principle of optimism to control our regret. More specifically, if a box is queried frequently, its query dataset grows and its index uncertainty decreases. If a box is queried rarely, then it contributes only rarely to the second term in Theorem3.3。这反映了 UCB 分析背后的经典自我修正原则，此处适用于管理保留指数和奖励，而不是强盗的直接反馈。. This mirrors the classic self-correcting principle behind UCB analysis, adapted here to govern reservation indices and reward rather than the direct feedback in bandits.

In contrast, our approach follows the principle of optimism from the UCB literature. As we illustrate, under suitable regularity conditions, it is not necessary to learn all boxes’ index functions uniformly well. Instead, it is enough to maintain optimistic index estimates and refine the estimates of boxes that remain relevant to the query process.

6 结论Conclusion

受 LLM 级联的推动，我们引入了一种在线上下文潘多拉魔盒模型，其中决策者按顺序查询 API 以按成本生成输出并部署单个输出，仅观察其下游奖励。这种以输出为中介的反馈背离了经典设置，在经典设置中，打开一个盒子会直接显示其奖励，并捕获了 LLM 级联系统的一个关键特征：特定于 API 的异质性仅通过生成的输出和成本的分布进入，而下游价值由上下文输出对上的共享奖励评估器控制。 我们不是估计完整的条件输出和成本分布，而是直接对保留指数和共享奖励函数施加广义线性结构。我们的Motivated by LLM cascading, we introduce an online contextual Pandora’s Box model in which a decision-maker sequentially queries APIs to generate outputs at a cost and deploys a single output, observing only its downstream reward. This output-mediated feedback departs from the classical setting, where opening a box reveals its reward directly, and captures a key feature of LLM cascading systems: API-specific heterogeneity enters only through the distributions of generated outputs and costs, while downstream value is governed by a shared reward evaluator on the context-output pair. Rather than estimating the full conditional output and cost distributions, we impose a generalized linear structure directly on the reservation indices and the shared reward function. Our宇宙COSMOS策略是通过将保留指数的 GMM 估计与指数和奖励评估器的 UCB 式置信界限相结合来构建的。通过乐观下的遗憾分解，将累积遗憾分为已部署输出的奖励估计误差和查询 API 的索引估计误差，我们得出policy is built by combining GMM estimation of the reservation indices with UCB-style confidence bounds for both the indices and the reward evaluator. Through a regret decomposition under optimism, which separates cumulative regret into reward-estimation errors for deployed outputs and index-estimation errors for queried APIs, we derive aO~​([d+A​(m+d​m)]​T)\widetilde{\mathrm{O}}\left([d+A(m+\sqrt{dm})]\sqrt{T}\right)后悔绑定。regret bound.

我们的工作为未来的研究开辟了多种途径。首先，由于我们的理论保证依赖于广义线性规范，因此将基于矩的 UCB 框架扩展到更丰富的非参数或神经表示是自然的下一步。 在保留的同时实现这一目标Our work opens several avenues for future research. First, because our theoretical guarantees rely on generalized linear specifications, extending the moment-based UCB framework to richer nonparametric or neural representations is a natural next step. Achieving this while preservingO~​(T)\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{T})遗憾会进一步扩大模型的适用性。其次，我们当前的表述假设采用标准的 LLM 级联结构，其中按顺序查询 API，选择单个输出然后进行部署。扩展此框架以允许在延迟预算下进行批量查询，或支持输出集成和合成，将显着改变查询选择动态。解决这些更丰富的行动空间引发了有关学习政策结构的引人注目的新问题。regret would further broaden the model’s applicability. Second, our current formulation assumes a standard LLM cascading structure where APIs are queried sequentially and a single output is selected and then deployed. Expanding this framework to allow for batched querying under latency budgets, or to support output ensembling and synthesis, would significantly change the query-selection dynamics. Addressing these richer action spaces raises compelling new questions about the structure of the learning policy.
